citations.assessment: The Bavli has the explicit patronymic Rav Acha son of Rav Yosef and places him before a Rav Yosef. It does not settle the identity of his father in the roster.
Bava Batra calls him Mar son of Rav Yosef. Heilprin’s separate entry preserves this name across sources.

holds.reason: Heilprin’s separate Rav Nachman heading sends the reader to Rav Nechemyah. Ketubot reads Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef. The two forms remain qualified rather than harmonized.
